notes: Use-case summary: Crowneon runs an omnichannel contact platform used by retail and telco customers. Primary ask: reliably serve agent-assist and auto-summarization during traffic spikes (Black Friday, product launches).
Key constraints: must run behind customer VPC, support on-prem connectors for legacy PBX, and provide audit logs for 7 years for regulated verticals.

Performance targets: 95th pctl latency < 250ms for short agent interactions (<= 64 tokens), sustain 1,200 concurrent active agent sessions during peak with graceful degradation under sustained bursts.
Throughput expectations: baseline 400 rps, peak burst target 4,000 rps for 10-20 minute windows, average query size ~50 tokens.
Quality and cost: willing to accept small quality delta for quantized models if unit cost reduction >= 30% — request Optimize recommendations.

Routing/fallback: require policy-based routing by customer SLA tier + region; automatic fallback to smaller/quantized variant if latency SLO at risk; runbook must include service-level rollback and canary split instructions.

Spike sim POC: Crowneon asked Redwood to run a 2-week spike simulator that recreates burst patterns (gradual ramp + microbursts) and report per-token cost breakdown, 95th/99th latency, error rate, and KV cache hit rates.
Security notes: SSO via SAML 2.0 already in place; legal flagged data residency for EU customers and wants KMS/HSM details. Need SOC2 attest and evidence of ISO27001 controls for private deployment.
Customer quote (Head of Ops): "We can live with a small drop in answer quality if the system never goes offline during peak promos — 5% failure is our absolute max."
Engineering quote (SRE lead): "Main failure mode today is queue backpressure — calls get delayed >30s which triggers customer escalations. Need prefix caching and better circuit breaker behavior."
Commercial: CRO wants a Dedicated reserved pool with burst capacity plus a Private control plane for top-10 enterprise accounts; target ARR band $500k-$1M for first year.
Open questions: SLA measurement windows (1m vs 5m), acceptable retry/backoff policy for agent-assist calls, and exact tagging requirements for audit logs.
Action items: SE to deliver spike sim plan (by 2026-03-10); Prod to provide model variants + quantization impact doc; Legal to draft residency addendum (expected 2 weeks).
